title: Ridgeline Installation Services Rescission and Cancellation Fee Schedule
content:
This schedule sets out, for each Ridgeline Installation Services program, the figures of the home-signing rescission right and of the cancellation fee charged when a signed agreement is cancelled outside that right.

## Rescission right figures

| Program | Rescission period (business days after signing) | Contract price at or above which the right applies (USD) | Right also applies to store or online signings |
|---|---|---|---|
| Ridgeline Carpet Installation | 3 | 130.00 | no |
| Ridgeline Hard Surface Flooring Installation | 3 | 130.00 | no |
| Ridgeline Window and Door Installation | 3 | 130.00 | no |
| Ridgeline Kitchen Cabinet and Countertop Installation | 3 | 130.00 | no |
| Ridgeline Bath Remodel Installation | 3 | 130.00 | no |
| Ridgeline Roofing and Siding Installation | 3 | 130.00 | no |

## Cancellation fee figures

| Program | Fee while no materials are ordered (percent of the contract price) | Fee once materials are ordered or received (percent of the contract price) | Minimum fee when a percentage fee applies (USD) | Customer may cancel once work has started |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Ridgeline Carpet Installation | 0 | 25 | 50.00 | no |
| Ridgeline Hard Surface Flooring Installation | 0 | 15 | 50.00 | no |
| Ridgeline Window and Door Installation | 10 | 50 | 150.00 | no |
| Ridgeline Kitchen Cabinet and Countertop Installation | 10 | 50 | 250.00 | no |
| Ridgeline Bath Remodel Installation | 10 | 35 | 250.00 | no |
| Ridgeline Roofing and Siding Installation | 10 | 25 | 250.00 | no |

## Notes

- The rescission figures are the same on every program: 3 business days, a contract price threshold of 130.00, and no right for agreements signed in the store or online.
- On the carpet and hard surface flooring programs the percentage before materials are ordered is 0, so no cancellation fee arises at that stage; the minimum fee applies only when a percentage fee applies.
- No program allows the customer to cancel once installation work has started.

## Hypothetical figure check

On a hypothetical Ridgeline Bath Remodel Installation contract of 9000.00 with materials ordered, 35 percent of the contract price is 3150.00, above the 250.00 minimum. On a hypothetical Ridgeline Carpet Installation contract of 150.00 with materials received, 25 percent is 37.50, so the 50.00 minimum is the fee.
